_help: Act 9, after the ritual defence: act9.gd sets ritual_done if a guardian finished the rite (else ritual_failed). Success: barrier_restored (end_restored). Failure: the guardian takes the amulet, and you and everyone with you die (player_died_in_tomb, end_failed). Then the epilogue. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act89.py.

done.speaker: player
done.line: The last note. The eye settles into its cradle with a click like a key in a lock, and every dead thing in the tomb falls where it stands. Silence. Dust.

noura_thanks.speaker: noura
noura_thanks.line: It is closed. Truly closed. Go home, all of you. Tell no one where this place is. That is how you can thank us.

omar_thanks.speaker: omar
omar_thanks.line: It is done. She would have... It is done. Go. And foreigner: thank you.

failed.speaker: player
failed.line: The chant breaks off. He walks between the fallen, picks up the amulet, and looks at me with something like pity.
